name: Eyes
description: Eyes pays a nearby human a few dollars to check something in a public place right now (is it open, how long is the line, is it in stock, how crowded is it) and returns a verified answer with a live photo.

httpAuthSecurityScheme.description: API key from POST /v1/signup, sent as Authorization: Bearer <api_key>.

skills.name: Quote a task
skills.description: Free and read-only. Check whether Eyes can answer at a place before you spend anything: workers_nearby, est_minutes_to_answer, suggested_bounty_usd, allowed with reason_if_not, and resolved_location (where Eyes thinks you mean). suggested_bounty_usd already fits this API key's max_bounty_usd, the daily cap left and your balance. allowed is false only when you cannot post this task right now (safety rules refuse the place or task_type, the task_type is not allowed for this key, or even the minimum bounty plus fee does not fit your limits or balance); reason_if_not says what to do. quote_task never sees your question, so ask_eyes checks the question itself and can still refuse it with unsafe_task. Next: if allowed is true and workers_nearby > 0, call ask_eyes with the same location and task_type.

skills.name: Ask a human to check
skills.description: Pay a nearby human to look at a public place right now and answer your question, usually with a live photo. bounty_usd (default 3) plus a 0.50 USD fee is escrowed from your balance now, paid to the worker only after a verified answer, and refunded in full if nobody answers before deadline_minutes or you cancel before a worker claims it. Always pass a unique idempotency_key: retrying with the same key and parameters returns the original task instead of charging again. Only public, commercial or civic places. Next: call await_answer with the returned task_id immediately.
examples: ask_eyes({"question":"How many people are waiting in line right now?","location":"Blue Bottle Coffee, Mint Plaza, San Francisco","task_type":"line_length","bounty_usd":3,"idempotency_key":"6f1c2a9e-line-check"})

skills.name: Wait for the answer
skills.description: Long-poll for the answer to a task. Each call waits up to timeout_seconds (default 50, max 55) and returns as soon as the task is answered. Call it right after ask_eyes and keep calling it with the same task_id until answered is true or status is expired, refunded or disputed; you cannot receive events in the background, so this loop is how you get the answer. answered: false only means not yet; tasks usually take 5 to 20 minutes.

skills.name: Get task status
skills.description: Instant, read-only status and details of one task, including the answer once there is one. To wait for an answer call await_answer instead of polling get_task.

skills.name: List your tasks
skills.description: Instant, read-only list of the tasks this API key created, newest first: task_id, status, question, place_label, bounty_usd, created_at, deadline_at and answered. Call it when you lost a task_id (context reset, crash) and before asking a question again, so you resume an open task instead of paying twice. status filters to one status; limit is 1 to 50 (default 20). Next: await_answer any task still dispatched, claimed or submitted; get_task any task where answered is true.

skills.name: Cancel a task
skills.description: Cancel a task that no worker has claimed yet (status dispatched) and refund the full escrow, bounty plus fee. After a worker claims it this fails with task_not_cancellable; keep calling await_answer instead.

skills.name: Dispute an answer
skills.description: Flag an answered task (status verified, paid or needs_review) as wrong. The worker payout is held and the task goes to human review. Give a specific reason. To get a fresh answer now, call ask_eyes again with a new idempotency_key.
examples: dispute_answer({"task_id":"3f0e8c1a-5b7d-4e2f-9a6b-1c2d3e4f5a6b","reason":"The photo shows a different cafe, not Blue Bottle."})

skills.name: Get balance
skills.description: Your prepaid balance and the amount escrowed in open tasks, in USD, plus top_up_url: a link your human opens to add funds with Stripe Checkout. If balance_usd is below bounty_usd + 0.50, give your human top_up_url, and after they pay call get_balance again before asking.

skills.name: Get spend policy
skills.description: The limits your human set on this API key: max_bounty_usd per task, daily_cap_usd, spent_today_usd and remaining_today_usd (UTC day), and allowed_task_types. Stay within them when you call ask_eyes; only your human can change them.
